title: T4 constrained lead optimization

environment.role: pinned production chemistry kernel for T4 and the editing corpus
environment.build: uv venv --python 3.11 <dir> && uv pip install --python <dir>/bin/python rdkit==2024.3.5 numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.13.1 networkx==3.3 torch==2.4.0 pytest
environment.why_torch: t4_fiber_campaign imports it transitively. Omitting it forces you to transcribe the eligibility gate instead of importing it, and a transcribed gate cannot fail usefully.
environment.not_the_pmo_kernel: PMO runs rdkit 2023.9.6. See experiments/pmo/manifest.json. Two production kernels exist in this repo and a number computed under the wrong one needs a parity statement.
environment.reproduction_needs_none_of_this: tools/reproduce_t4_table.py reads only committed JSON and runs on a bare python3.

inputs.role: shared per-cell launcher; held-target apps are 9-line env wrappers

missing_assets.what: QuickVina2 docking binary and receptor boxes
missing_assets.where: baked into the Modal image; not in the repo

missing_assets.what: per-cell Modal volumes (compose-t4-*), holding round locks and checkpoints
missing_assets.where: Modal volumes under two profiles; a volume NAME is not a volume identity, so pin the profile and creation date before concluding an artifact is absent

known_discrepancies.what: delta 0.6 stored sum_gap = -7.6, but the rows sum to -8.5
known_discrepancies.corroboration: compose_sum - ivg_sum = -8.5 and mean_gap * paired_cells = -8.4994 both agree with the rows; only sum_gap disagrees
known_discrepancies.direction: the stored value UNDERSTATES COMPOSE's aggregate margin by 0.9 kcal/mol
known_discrepancies.handling: tools/reproduce_t4_table.py prints the row sum, flags the stored field, and exits 1. The frozen artifact is LOCKED and was deliberately NOT edited.

caveats_carried_by_the_artifact: Docking is not reproducible across runs: obabel --gen3D takes no seed, and one molecule scored -7.5 / -8.30 / -8.8 across three runs. Quote the aggregate and the win count; do not lean on a single cell's 0.2-0.7 margin.
One blank cell (FA7 seed 1, delta 0.6) is a deliberate scoped negative, not a missing measurement.
scope: Protocol, pinned environment and required external assets. Measured scores are not shipped; see experiments/paper/ for what the submission reports and which module implements it.
